description:
Intent i030 (SNAPSHOT=s08, BRANCH=alloc-multiply-overflow) complete. Final artifact: /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C9/agent-state/findings/i030.json with snapshots_checked=["s08"], 1 finding, 12 candidates, 5 limitations.

FINDING (medium confidence): snapshots/s08 drivers/virt/fsl_hypervisor.c:218-221, literal quote 'if (param.count == 0 ||\n\t    param.count > U64_MAX - lb_offset - PAGE_SIZE + 1)\n\t\treturn -EINVAL;\n\tnum_pages = (param.count + lb_offset + PAGE_SIZE - 1) >> PAGE_SHIFT;' — FSL_HV_IOCTL_MEMCPY ioctl copies a userspace-controlled u64 param.count via copy_from_user (line 165); num_pages is declared unsigned int and computed as a 64-bit u64 addition whose result truncates to 32 bits with no clamp (the 218-220 guard only prevents u64 addition overflow, not the 64->32 truncation); kmalloc(num_pages * sizeof(struct fh_sg_list) + ..., GFP_KERNEL) at lines 239-240 is a plain 32-bit multiply (32-byte element), and the fill loop 'for (i = 1; i < num_pages; i++) sg_list[i].source/.target/.size = ...' (lines ~340-353) writes one element per iteration for the full untruncated count, so a wrapped product (e.g. num_pages 2^27 * 32 = 2^32 -> 0) yields kmalloc(31) followed by gigabytes of heap writes. Same mechanism and instance family as f007 (s02). Second low-confidence reported candidate: block/partitions/ldm.c:1247 'kmalloc(sizeof(*f) + size*num, GFP_KERNEL)' in ldm_frag_add where size = ldb->vm.vblk_size is a raw on-disk be32 (ldm.c:187, only zero-checked) and the memcpy at line 1293 copies 'size' bytes at offset rec*size into the fragment — reachability gated by perbuf = 512/size in the caller, recorded in limitations as unproven.

SAFE classifications with evidence: gve_adminq.c:1103 (num_entries driver-computed), vfio_ccw_cp.c:514 (kcalloc sizes the array, idal_len only under-reads), rds/message.c:339, ethtool/bitset.c:249 (nla_len-bounded), xfs_inode_fork.c:117, sctp/sm_make_chunk.c:3683 (__u16 product max 131070), enetc_cbdr.c:9 (compile-time constant), tas571x.c:183 (driver constant 5), fat/dir.c:1351 (locally accumulated). Seed exclusion honored: s08 carries the UNPATCHED seed chain (usbip_common.c:665 'int size = np * sizeof(*iso);' with unclamped wire store at 473 and USBIP_MAX_ISO_PACKETS enforced only on CMD_SUBMIT at stub_rx.c:379-384) recorded as unresolved/excluded-by-rule, not reported. No compilation or runtime reproducer was run (read-only snapshot); the fsl_hypervisor instance additionally requires /dev/fsl-hv (root-owned) access and successful page pinning, and the ldm instance's perbuf gating was not fully resolved — both expressed via confidence and limitations.
